rubric: A response passes only if it explicitly compares reference and candidate rest-to-limit direction, correctly states match versus mismatch, and does not misclassify the USB prismatic motion as rotation.

cases.note: Correctly contrasts edge-on reference folding with the diagonal candidate swing.
Correctly identifies the shared broad-to-edge-on motion.
Correctly contrasts the reference extension with the opposite folded candidate trajectory.
Correctly contrasts downward reference motion with the candidate's sideways departure.
Correctly contrasts out-of-plane yaw with in-plane diagonal tilt.
Correctly identifies the matching outward and downward motion.
Correctly identifies horizontal reference sliding versus a downward folded candidate; it does not assume rotation.
Correctly identifies matching rightward prismatic sliding.
